column1: # Labelled exam lines for the school-calendar parser eval (evals/calendar.eval.js).
# Source: the exam texts of the school's published exam calendar (grades י, י"א, י"ב, school year 2026/27) — public
# text with no personal data. Each line is: text <TAB> subject <TAB> type <TAB> sitting.
# The labels were written by reading the text, NOT by running the parser, so the score measures the parser.
#   subject  the subject the student would expect, spelled like the app spells it (typos in the source are corrected)
#   type     quiz (בוחן) | test (מבחן, מסכם, anything else) | exam (מתכונת = mock) | bagrut | project (מעבדה = lab)
#   sitting  A = first sitting of a bagrut, B = second sitting (מועד ב' / מועד נוסף), - = not stated
# A subject of "?" means the text is ambiguous on its own (e.g. "ספרות אנגלית" may be English literature); such
# lines are listed so nobody re-labels them by guesswork, but they are not scored.
י"א - מבחן גוש ב - מועד ב'
י"ב - בגרות - מועד ב' אנגלית דבורה
י"ב - מועד ב' חדוא א' (מכללת אפקה)
יוד - מבחן גוש א' מועד ב'
יוד - מבחן גוש ב' מועד ב
